name: coucou-context
description: Tells Lumo (the character at the top of the screen on macOS, Windows and Linux) which file you're in, the cursor, the selection and the editor's problems, so it answers with exact context.

coucou.shareContext.description: Keep Lumo updated with the active file, cursor, selection and problems (stays on this computer, over a local socket or pipe).

coucou.showStatusBar.description: Show the "Lumo" button in the status bar.
